# Vendored code

`ff_wasm_unknown_unknown/` is copied unchanged from
https://github.com/hideyour-cash/hideyour-cash/tree/6f27e38ec543bc392c00c9201c19f783a485b655/packages/contract-libraries/ff_wasm_unknown_unknown
(MIT or Apache 2.0, a wasm friendly copy of zkcrypto/ff by Sean Bowe and Jack Grigg, adapted by hack-a-chain for the
hideyour.cash NEAR mixer). Only its `rust-toolchain` file was removed so the crate builds with this repo's toolchain.
